0774 'Arpad {ar-pa:d'} 或 (#賽 10:9|) 'Arpad {ar-pad'}

源自 07502; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Arpad 4, Arphad 2; 6

亞珥拔 = "我將得伸展 (或得支持)"
1) 敘利亞北部的城市, 援引為亞述人征服的儆戒 (#王下 18:34|)

0774 'Arpad {ar-pawd'}

from 07502;; n pr loc

AV - Arpad 4, Arphad 2; 6

Arpad or Arphad = "I shall be spread out (or supported)"
1) a city in northern Syria cited as an example of the Assyrian conquest
